sentences.en: Those agenda items were taken up en bloc for discussion.
sentences.zh: 这些议程项目被整体拿出来讨论。

sentences.en: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来讨论议程上的下一个项目。

sentences.en: Bouteflika's foreign agenda was a great strength of his government.
sentences.zh: 布特弗利卡的外交政策是其政府的一大优势。

senses.zh: 议事日程,待议诸事项一览表,日常工作事项,议程（ agendum的名词复数）
